options.note: REAL multi-portal discovery via your own Apify account. Set APIFY_TOKEN in .env, set enabled:true, then list one or more actors. Each actor: { actorId: 'username~actor-name', label, source, input: {...actor-specific...}, fieldMap?: {...overrides...} }. Or read a previous run: { datasetId: '...' }. Find actors at https://apify.com/store (search 'jobs').

Nationwide US discovery via LinkedIn through YOUR OWN Apify account using valig~linkedin-jobs-scraper. PAY-PER-RESULT (~$0.0004/job + ~$0.001/run on the FREE plan). Compliance: official Apify REST API with your token only; no login replay, CAPTCHA solving, or evasion. Searches cover the past month and the candidate's major Data Engineering, Data Platform, Analytics Engineering, BI, Data Warehouse, ETL, and Power BI title families. Deduplication and skill scoring rank overlap. Each search's limit caps results and cost.

QUERY-FIRST DISCOVERY, no API key, no per-run cost. Searches ACROSS every employer hosted by an ATS vendor instead of enumerating one configured board at a time — this is the capability the paid Apify actors provided. Queries default to candidate.targetTitles so the title list lives in exactly one place. Both providers OR-match query terms, so queries are phrase-quoted and every hit must clear a title gate before it is kept. Providers: 'workable' (real pagination, full JD inline, relevance-ranked so dayRange is the only recency lever) and 'smartrecruiters' (already newest-first; newest 100 per query, server ignores offset). Public unauthenticated vendor search endpoints only — no login, CAPTCHA solving, or evasion.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-01 with a real key (docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md). Official Adzuna aggregator API — the closest legitimate substitute for Apify's Indeed/LinkedIn breadth. Queries default to candidate.targetTitles; 17 titles x 2 pages daily is ~1,020 calls/month against the ~1,000/month free-tier cap, so lower maxPages to 1 or set maxQueries if you approach it. `what_phrase` matches anywhere in the posting body, not just the title (a bare 'Data Engineer' query returned 31,148 hits including unrelated roles) — a client-side title gate (same one atsSearch uses) filters this; disable with strictTitleMatch:false if it ever drops something you wanted.

DISCOVERY. Greenhouse board tokens (the company slug in boards.greenhouse.io/<token>). These are verified-live H-1B-friendly tech companies that currently list Data/BI/Analytics-Engineer roles. A dead/empty board is logged and skipped, never crashes the run.
DISCOVERY. Lever company slugs (jobs.lever.co/<slug>). Verified-live boards that currently list Data/Analytics roles.
URL READER ONLY. Not a real search adapter. Supply public Dice posting URLs in `urls`; `queries` are not automated.
URL READER ONLY. Public /jobs/view/ pages supplied in `urls`. No login automation, no evasion, no query search.

options.note: Search phrases are DERIVED from candidate.targetTitles (see deriveSearchTerms in src/search/adapters/workday.js) — adding a target title changes what every tenant is searched for, with no per-tenant edit. Workday's CXS search is fuzzy-AND: it NARROWS as tokens are added, so phrases are kept to two tokens and the set is a minimal cover of the title list. Pin 'searchTexts' here to override globally, or 'searchText'/'searchTexts' on a single tenant.

DISCOVERY. Public company careers pages only. Each entry is one of: { name, ats: 'greenhouse'|'lever'|'workday', slug/host/tenant/site } (delegates to the official API adapter), { name, careersUrl } (scrape public job links), or { name, sitemap } (read a public sitemap.xml). Blocked pages (401/403/429/CAPTCHA/login) are logged and skipped — never bypassed.
URL READER ONLY. Parses public posting URLs you supply in `urls`. Performs no search/discovery.
DISCOVERY via Ashby's official public posting API (api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<board>). Board slugs of tech companies hiring data roles; a dead board is logged and skipped.

DISCOVERY via SmartRecruiters' official public Posting API (api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/<id>/postings). Pages through `offset` until totalFound is reached — it previously read only the first 100 postings per company, which silently truncated ServiceNow (442) and Experian (495). List endpoint has no full JD; jdText is synthesized from posting metadata and the human reviews the real posting. Bosch and IKEA were removed after both returned 0 postings on verification.
